segs.en: L. Convert to heap

zh.ai: L. 转换为堆

segs.en: You have a tree with $$$n$$$ vertices ($$$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$$$), numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ and rooted at node $$$1$$$. Every node $$$i$$$ has an integer value $$$a_i$$$ ($$$0 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$).

zh.ai: 你有一棵包含 $$$n$$$ 个顶点的树($$$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$$$)，其顶点编号从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$，根节点为 $$$1$$$。每个节点 $$$i$$$ 都有一个整数值 $$$a_i$$$($$$0 \leq a_i \leq 10^9$$$)。

segs.en: You can update the values of the nodes $$$q$$$ times ($$$1 \leq q \leq 1000$$$). In the $$$i$$$-th update, you can choose a subset of nodes and increase the value of all of them by $$$x_i$$$ ($$$1 \leq x_i \leq 1000$$$).

zh.ai: 你可以更新节点的值 $$$q$$$ 次($$$1 \leq q \leq 1000$$$)。在第 $$$i$$$ 次更新中，你可以选择一个节点子集，并将其中所有节点的值增加 $$$x_i$$$($$$1 \leq x_i \leq 1000$$$)。

segs.en: You task is to use these updates to convert the tree into a heap. The tree is considered a heap if and only if every non-root node has a value less than or equal to the value of its parent. Since there can be multiple ways to do this, you must choose the one that minimizes $$$\sum_{i=1}^n a_i$$$.

zh.ai: 你的任务是通过这些更新将这棵树转换为堆。当且仅当每个非根节点的值都小于或等于其父节点的值时，这棵树才被视为堆。由于可能有多种转换方式，你必须选择使 $$$\sum_{i=1}^n a_i$$$ 最小的方案。

segs.en: The first line of input contains two space separated integers: $$$n$$$ and $$$q$$$.

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个由空格分隔的整数：$$$n$$$ 和 $$$q$$$。

segs.en: The second line contains $$$n$$$ space separated integers: $$$a_i$$$.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$n$$$ 个空格分隔的整数：$$$a_i$$$。

segs.en: Each of the next $$$n-1$$$ lines describe the edges of the tree, each contains two space separated integers: $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$ (Meaning there is an edge between $$$u$$$ and $$$v$$$).

zh.ai: 接下来的 $$$n-1$$$ 行中的每一行描述树的一条边，每行包含两个以空格分隔的整数：$$$u$$$ 和 $$$v$$$(表示 $$$u$$$ 和 $$$v$$$ 之间存在一条边)。

segs.en: The next and final line of input contains $$$q$$$ space separated integers: $$$x_i$$$.

zh.ai: 输入的下一行也是最后一行，包含 $$$q$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数：$$$x_i$$$。

segs.en: If there is a way to convert the tree into a heap, output the minimum $$$\sum_{i=1}^n a_i$$$ after converting it to a heap. Otherwise output -1.

zh.ai: 如果可以将这棵树转换为堆，则输出转换为堆后最小的 $$$\sum_{i=1}^n a_i$$$。否则输出 -1。

segs.en: F. Flow of binary matrix

zh.ai: F. 二进制矩阵的流

segs.en: A binary matrix is a matrix that has either $$$0$$$ or $$$1$$$ in all of its cells. The flow of a binary matrix is the number of rows contain only $$$1$$$'s plus the number of columns that contain only $$$1$$$'s, for example, here is a matrix with flow 3:

zh.ai: 二进制矩阵是指所有单元格均为 $$$0$$$ 或 $$$1$$$ 的矩阵。二进制矩阵的流量等于只包含 $$$1$$$ 的行数加上只包含 $$$1$$$ 的列数。例如，下面是一个流量为 3 的矩阵：

segs.en: The flow is $$$3$$$ because row $$$2$$$ and columns $$$1$$$ and $$$4$$$ are full of $$$1$$$s.

You are given a binary matrix of size $$$n \times n$$$, and you have to write a program to perform several operations, and for each operation your program must output the flow of the matrix after applying the operation. There are two types of operations:

zh.ai: 给定一个大小为 $$$n \times n$$$ 的二进制矩阵，你需要编写一个程序执行若干操作，并且对于每次操作，程序都必须输出应用该操作后矩阵的流。操作有两种：

segs.en: 1 i j b — updates the value in the $$$i$$$-th row and the $$$j$$$-th column to be equal to $$$b$$$ ($$$1 \leq i, j \leq n$$$ and $$$b$$$ is either $$$0$$$ or $$$1$$$).

2 b — inserts the value $$$b$$$ ($$$b$$$ is either $$$0$$$ or $$$1$$$) in the matrix at position $$$(1,1)$$$, this moves all values of the first row $$$1$$$ column to the right, the last element of the first row is removed from the first row and inserted as the first element of the second row, causing a cascade behavior that ends up in the last row having $$$n+1$$$ elements. The last value of the $$$n$$$-th row is discarded and the matrix will still have dimensions $$$n \times n$$$.

zh.ai: 2 b — 将值 $$$b$$$($$$b$$$ 为 $$$0$$$ 或 $$$1$$$)插入矩阵中的位置 $$$(1,1)$$$，这会将第一行中 $$$1$$$ 列右侧的所有值向右移动；第一行的最后一个元素会从第一行移除，并作为第二行的第一个元素插入，从而产生级联效果，最终使最后一行有 $$$n+1$$$ 个元素。$$$n$$$ 行的最后一个值会被丢弃，而矩阵的维度仍为 $$$n \times n$$$。

segs.en: The first line of input contains two space separated integers: $$$n$$$ and $$$q$$$ ($$$2 \leq n \leq 5000$$$ and $$$1 \leq q \leq 5000$$$).

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个由空格分隔的整数：$$$n$$$ 和 $$$q$$$($$$2 \leq n \leq 5000$$$ 和 $$$1 \leq q \leq 5000$$$)。

segs.en: The next $$$n$$$ lines describe the binary matrix. The $$$j$$$-th character of the $$$i$$$-th line is the value of the binary matrix at position $$$(i,j)$$$.

zh.ai: 接下来的 $$$n$$$ 行描述二进制矩阵。第 $$$i$$$ 行的第 $$$j$$$ 个字符是二进制矩阵在位置 $$$(i,j)$$$ 处的值。

segs.en: The next $$$q$$$ lines each contain an operation. The operations follow the format described in the statement.

zh.ai: 接下来的 $$$q$$$ 行每行包含一个操作。操作格式如题面所述。

segs.en: $$$q$$$ lines, the $$$i$$$-th line must contain the flow of the binary matrix after applying the $$$i$$$-th operation.

zh.ai: 接下来的 $$$q$$$ 行中，第 $$$i$$$ 行必须包含对二进制矩阵执行第 $$$i$$$ 次操作后的网络流。

segs.en: E. Finding progressions

zh.ai: E. 寻找等差数列

segs.en: Catalina needs help with her Math homework, which consists of finding all the increasing arithmetic progressions of integers (*) that meet the following conditions:

zh.ai: Catalina需要帮助完成她的数学作业，作业内容是找出所有满足以下条件的递增整数等差数列（*）：

segs.en: The progression contains the number $$$A$$$

zh.ai: 这个数列包含数字 $$$A$$$

segs.en: The sum of the terms of the progression is $$$S$$$

zh.ai: 该数列各项的和为 $$$S$$$

segs.en: All terms of the progression are in the range $$$[L, R]$$$

zh.ai: 该数列的所有项都在 $$$[L, R]$$$ 范围内。

segs.en: Catalina is a responsible girl and doesn't want someone else to solve the task for her, but she could use a little help. What Catalina needs is for you to tell her how many progressions exist under these conditions, so that she could know when to stop searching.

zh.ai: Catalina是个负责任的女孩，不想让别人替她完成这道题，但她需要一点帮助。她需要你告诉她在这些条件下存在多少个等差数列，这样她就知道何时该停止搜索。

segs.en: (*) An increasing arithmetic progression of integers is a non-empty list of $$$n$$$ integer numbers $$$x_1, x_2, \ldots , x_n$$$ where $$$x_i - x_{i-1} = D  \gt  0$$$ for every integer $$$i$$$ such that $$$2 \leq i \leq n$$$, where $$$D$$$ is a positive integer. For example, $$$[7]$$$, $$$[1, 2, 3]$$$ and $$$[2, 4, 6, 8]$$$ are valid progressions, but $$$[5, 1]$$$, $$$[2, 4, 8]$$$ and $$$[3, 6, 9, 6]$$$ are not.
A single line with four integers $$$A$$$, $$$S$$$, $$$L$$$ and $$$R$$$ ($$$1 \leq L \leq A \leq R \leq 10^{12}$$$, $$$1 \leq S \leq 10^{18}$$$, $$$0 \leq R-L \leq 10^5$$$).
A single line with an integer indicating how many progressions meet the conditions described by the statement.

zh.ai: 一行包含一个整数，表示满足题目描述条件的等差数列数量。
